method.sampling: Post-remediation recheck of the same targeted samples, retaining source record references and current target locations.
checks: identity name, namespace, source provenance, alias, normalized kind, and source-native kind preservation
field offsets, source access, role/type claims, grouped claims, and layout-owner linkage

method.evidence_rule: A sampled pass means the target retains the bounded source claim. Static evidence is not promoted to original runtime evidence.

findings.observation: The original five examples are now normalized: cCellGame is global_state, cCellObjectData is record, cGameInputManager and cCellModeStrategy are class, and ResourceKey is value_type. cEditor, cObjectPool<cCellObjectData>, and cEmpire remain unknown_candidate despite source-native roles.
findings.impact: Three sampled source kinds remain unavailable in the normalized dimension, although their source-native claims and identity qualifications are retained.

findings.observation: All ten sampled WA-02 field groups now retain their source offsets in offset_claims and retain source access, role, source type ID, and grouped source claims. The fields also expose layout_owner_type_ids.
findings.impact: The sampled CellGame and CellObjectData compatibility anchors can be traversed from the target fields and canonical type linkage.

findings.observation: VT:01485550 links to CONFLICT:2bdc94b5e38ac8da1c90487e and VT:01490be8 links to CONFLICT:72bb6c455c2d655bfed033f8; both conflict records retain their alternatives and unresolved decisions.
findings.impact: A consumer following vtable_ids can now reach the preserved owner disagreement without selecting a namespace.

findings.observation: All eight sampled lifecycle records now have operation_phases and source_phase_claims, retain operation text, and retain runtime_observed=false. Some source subphases still normalize to unknown, including allocate, create_effect, create_rollover, and reuse.
findings.impact: Lifecycle records are now machine-readable, but not every source operation has a distinct normalized phase.

findings.observation: The sampled method records now retain source-native kind claims and improved normalized kinds: accessor, factory, dispatch, and serialization are present. cCellGFX::Initialize and cCellGame::Initialize remain broad kind=method, and cGameBehaviorManager::Get remains unknown because the source has no explicit kind.
findings.impact: The source operation category is no longer lost, but consumers using only normalized method kind still lose some initializer/accessor distinctions.

findings.observation: All eight sampled WA-15 records now retain the exact source classification in source_classification. The source domain is also retained, including explicit null for the two source records that provide no domain. The normalized classification field remains broader or unknown but no longer replaces the exact source value.
findings.impact: Exact-layout, semantic-interface, and replaceable-infrastructure distinctions remain available from the target without re-reading worker 15.

findings.observation: cCellGame now has eight canonical field_ids, and the sampled shared-layout fields have layout_owner_type_ids pointing to cCellGame or cCellObjectData. The prior cCellGame-to-field traversal gap is closed for the sampled fields.
findings.impact: The sampled canonical type-to-field relationship is traversable without assigning unrelated global fields by proximity.

findings.observation: Sampled methods retain runtime_observed=false; unresolved vtable owners remain candidates; structural relations remain non-RTTI; conflict alternatives remain preserved; no original-runtime or RTTI promotion was observed.
findings.impact: The remediated projection improves semantic retention without introducing unsupported runtime or language-inheritance claims.

conclusion.verdict: The remediated target substantially improves semantic retention: field offsets and owner links, disputed-vtable conflict links, lifecycle phase maps, method source-kind claims, and exact reconstruction classifications are now present. The original semantic spot-check findings are resolved or substantially resolved, but high/medium residual gaps remain in type-kind coverage, cCellGame layout projection, cGameInputManager field linkage, lifecycle subphase mapping, and normalized method-kind coverage.
